controls.dropdown-view.dropdown.note: Name of the dropdown control module (a list of options to pick one from). Shown as its label in the card.

controls.dropdown-view.no-options.note: Shown in a dropdown control when the entity offers no options to choose from.

controls.light-view.effect.note: Label of the light effect picker (a built-in light effect such as colour loop). A noun, not a verb.

controls.light-view.light.note: Name of the light control module. A noun: a lamp entity in Home Assistant.

controls.light-view.name-colour.note: Accessible label of the colour picker of a light. {name} is the light's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

controls.light-view.name-effect.note: Accessible label of the effect picker of a light. {name} is the light's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

controls.light-view.toggle-name.note: Accessible label of the on/off switch of a light. {name} is the light's name. Toggle is a verb.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

controls.spinbox-view.decrease-name.note: Accessible label of the minus button of a number control. {name} is the entity's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

controls.spinbox-view.increase-name.note: Accessible label of the plus button of a number control. {name} is the entity's name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

controls.spinbox-view.spinbox.note: Name of the spinbox control module (a number field with plus and minus buttons).
